headline: AI chip stocks were riding high. Here’s why Micron and others are now pulling back.
detail: This directly impacts your highly concentrated tech/chip portfolio. A sector-wide pullback, even after a strong run, means increased risk for your SOXL, SMH, and SPAL positions, especially with margin.
rec: Consider trimming SMH, which is already flagged for TRIM and down -10.47%. Respect its 540 stop.

headline: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high, on inflation and spending concerns
detail: Surging Treasury yields are a significant headwind for growth and tech stocks like yours. Higher yields make future earnings less attractive and increase borrowing costs, putting pressure on valuations across your portfolio.
rec: Given the macro pressure, avoid adding to leveraged tech/chip positions. Review SOXL (-49.27%) and SPAL (-36.54%) for potential cuts to reduce margin exposure.

headline: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT for Teens experience with 'stronger built-in safety protections'
